data.title: 奥萝拉 · 血月寒潭的指尖涟漪
data.description: 静止在记忆断层的倒影深潭上。天上血月如盘。奥萝拉侧坐于水面之上，单足挑起一圈泛着绯红微光的涟漪，乌黑长发如瀑散落，指尖轻勾着发梢，以看透万载岁月的慵懒调侃目光注视着暗影大人。
data.location: surreal glass-calm lake surface beneath an ominous giant crimson blood moon
data.action: sitting perched lightly on mirror water, one foot dipping to create glowing crimson ripples, winding a lock of raven hair around a finger with a teasing sly smile
data.lighting: hypnotic crimson moonbeams reflecting off dark liquid surface with eerie violet magical haze
data.mood: ancient bewitching allure, timeless melancholy, playful gothic seduction
data.promptProse: Aurora in a strappy crimson bikini sits on a mirror lake under a giant blood moon, twirling her dark hair with a sly teasing glance.
data.animaCaption: Aurora lounging on a blood moon mirror lake teasing with ripples and a knowing smirk.
